    Power for the PPI++ OLS estimator

    power_ppi_pp_ols.Rd

    Power for the PPI++ OLS estimator

    power_ppi_pp_ols(
  delta,
  contrast,
  H_L,
  H_U,
  Sigma_YY,
  Sigma_ff_l,
  Sigma_ff_u,
  Sigma_Yf,
  N,
  n,
  lambda,
  alpha = 0.05,
  tol = 1e-12
)

    Arguments

    delta

    Effect size for the contrast \(c^\top(\beta - \beta_0)\).

    contrast

    Numeric vector (length = number of regressors) identifying the contrast.

    H_L

    Empirical Gram matrices for labeled designs (per observation).

    H_U

    Empirical Gram matrices for unlabeled designs (per observation).

    Sigma_YY

    Variance of the labeled score \(X(Y - X^\top\beta^\star)\).

    Sigma_ff_l

    Variances of \(X(f(X) - X^\top\beta^\star)\) under labeled draws.

    Sigma_ff_u

    Variances of \(X(f(X) - X^\top\beta^\star)\) under unlabeled draws.

    Sigma_Yf

    Covariance between the labeled score and prediction residual score.

    N

    Unlabeled sample sizes.

    n

    Labeled sample sizes.

    lambda

    Blend weight. Supply the same value used in estimation.

    alpha

    Two-sided test level.

    tol

    Numerical tolerance passed to linear solves.

    Value

    Scalar power in \([0,1]\).
